    Established in 1996, the Indian Institute of Management, Indore, is the sixth addition to the prestigious IIM family of management schools.     Programme Overview

    426:

    Accredited by European Quality Improvement System (EQUIS), Association of Advance Collegiate Schools of Business (AACSB-US based accreditation agency) and Association of MBAs, London (AMBA—UK based accreditation agency) the Post Graduate Programme (PGP) in Management at IIM Indore is a two-year, full-time, residential programme.It is also recognized by the Association of Indian Universities and is considered equivalent to the MBA Degree. The programme aims to groom participants into competent professional managers with

    443:

    Mission

    456:

    Learning Goals

    457:

    Learning goals of PGP are aligned with the mission of the Institute. Specific learning goals of the PGP programme are as follows.

    464:

    Goal 1

    Develop Critical Thinking

    470:

    Goal 2

    Ability to Work in Groups Effectively

    476:

    Goal 3

    Develop Competence in Quantitative Analysis

    482:

    Goal 4

    Prepare socially conscious and ethically motivated managers, leaders and entrepreneurs

    488:

    The PGP is spread over two years, each year consisting of three terms. In between the first and second years, the participant spends eight weeks on a summer project in a business organization. The academic year begins in June/July and ends in March/April of the following year.

    489:

    Based on feedback from the corporate sector, benchmarking against globally top-ranked MBA programmes and insights from recent studies on the effectiveness of MBA programmes, IIM Indore has launched a new PGP (MBA) programme design from its 2016-18 Batch.

    504:

    Blending Theory & Practice

    505:

    Another initiative to blend theory and practice is the hiring of professors of practice, which allows industry professionals with 15-20 years of experience to become a part of the IIM Indore full-time faculty. These professors of practice are already making a difference with case-writing projects on SBI, Godrej and BHEL, and a new consulting practicum to be offered in the second-year PGP.

    506:

    IIM Indore retains and reinforces some differentiating features from its earlier programme design:

    508:
  • Unique Rural Engagement Programme to give graduates contextual connect: To enable the participants to understand the social context in which organizations work and exist, an exposure to the rural settings of Madhya Pradesh is included in the course design.
    • 510:
  • Himalayan Outbound Programme (HoP) for PGP-II participants: While participants are adequately prepared for a corporate career, their ability to motivate themselves to perform in an unfamiliar ambience and work as a team is enhanced by encouraging them to undergo an outbound exercise and simulation conducted in serene locations at various altitudes in the Himalayas. While participants get to pursue electives of their choice, they are also given an opportunity to register for workshops to get focused knowledge on the skills and practices applicable to specific functional domains. This year, due to the ongoing pandemic, we could not organize HOP. Instead the participants were permitted to subscribe another equivalent electives of their choice.
    • 513:
  • Strong Participant Exchange Programme: IIM Indore has exchange tie-ups with several prestigious international business schools. A large number of participants visit these business schools and complete one semester there.
    • 515:

    Certificate of Percentage equivalent to CGPA 
    517:

    AIU Recognition Certificate

    531:

    Pedagogy

    IIM Indore uses a combination of various teaching methods such as cases, projects, computer aided instructions, group discussions, lectures, seminars, presentations by participants and lectures by guest speakers from industry and government. The case method is the predominant pedagogical tool. This sharpens the analytical skills of participants and helps analyze problems from multi- functional perspectives. Instructors mainly guide the group, push participants to develop and defend arguments and take decisions.

    536: 540:

    Programme Fees

    The course fee for resident Indians (for two years) is Rs. 24,11,800/- (Rupees Twenty Four lakhs eleven thousand and eight hundred only) and Rs. 36,11,800/- (Rupees Thirty Six lakhs eleven thousand and eight hundred only) for NRI Candidates. The course fee includes access to lectures, computer facilities, library etc. It also includes alumni fee and lodging. Course fee does not include the cost of textbooks, Mess fees, insurance, etc.

    549:

    Structure

    The Post Graduate Programme lasts six trimesters, spread over two years, with a summer project in between the two years. This eight-week programme is an opportunity for participants to put their ideas and skills in to work, in established and reputed companies from various sectors.

    550:

    The first year participants are given the fundamental knowledge, analytical skills & techniques, contextual understanding, environmental awareness and overall perspective, which will serve as the bedrock for the programme. The areas covered are Marketing, Finance, Human Resource Management, Quantitative Research, Operations, Economics and Strategy.

        Academic Year 2026 – 27

        426:

        Introduction

        427:

        The Executive Post Graduate Programme in Management (EPGP) is an intensive one-year full-time residential MBA program of IIM Indore. EPGP is specially designed for experienced professionals to enhance their knowledge, skills, and capabilities essential for managing and leading organizations. The programme combines skill building with the exploration of good management practices. This intensive one-year program helps participants gain the knowledge and skills required to excel in today’s fast-changing corporate environment. IIM Indore is again in the Top 100 Business Schools in the FT Rankings in the Global MBA Programmes 2026. IIM Indore has made a remarkable jump of 7 ranks, up from #69 in 2025 to #62 in 2026. Apart from the AMBA accreditation, EFMD Quality Improvement System (EQUIS), and US-based Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business (AACSB). This Triple Crown combination of accreditations is held by less than one percent of business schools in the world, granted by the largest and most influential business school accreditation agencies. In the EPGP programme, apart from the comprehensive functional core module, there are elective courses aligned with the industry concentration identified for the programme such as analytics, BFSI, e-Commerce, marketing, operations & strategy, etc.  The program carefully knits together all aspects of business and general management concepts, management philosophies, and varied academic theories. The curriculum of EPGP is a prudent mix of participant centric case-based learning, international immersion program, business analytics, industry consulting module, and guest lectures.

        428:

        The inauguration for the 18th batch of IIM Indore EPGP for the academic year 2026-27 took place on April 3, 2026. The 2026-27 batch of EPGP comprises of 58 participants, including 11 women and 47 men, from a very diverse group of high calibre professionals from varied backgrounds, functional roles, and industries. The batch’s average experience is around seven years.

                        427:

                        About IIM Indore

                        428:

                        Established in 1996, the Indian Institute of Management, Indore, is the sixth addition to the prestigious IIM family of management schools. Indore was chosen to host the school to give an impetus to management education in Central India and since then, the institute has pioneered various initiatives in the field of management interfacing with the industry, government sectors, and PSUs. The essence of management, IIM Indore believes, lies in managing one’s own ambitions and forging ahead consciously. A strong theoretical foundation is the basis of good corporate practice. Hence, IIM Indore offers a range of programmes such as the PGP, IPM (Integrated five year Programme), EPGP (for experienced professionals), PGPMX (for working executives, from Mumbai campus), GMPE (for working executives, from Indore campus), besides various management development programmes on both online and physical mode.

                        429:

                        The DPM, EDPM and EDPMG are the doctoral programmes of the institute.

                        436:

                        Mission

                        455:

                        EDPMG at IIMI

                        456:

                        The Executive Doctoral Programme in Management and Governance (EDPMG) is a unique doctoral programme for working Senior Officers in the Indian Administrative Services and Indian Armed Forces. Initiated in 2021, the program is one of the first such programs for officers offered by an IIM, which culminates with a PhD degree in management. The programme offers rigorous course work and the opportunity to pursue research under the guidance of some of the best management researchers. IIM Indore currently has one of the biggest cohorts of doctoral candidates (more than 200 across both its doctoral programmes) in the management domain in the country. The programme is expected to enable IIM Indore to contribute to effective governance of the country and nation-building. Also, it will leverage the experience and capability of the country’s civil servants, army officers and public managers, while building their capability, and making them research inclined.

                        457:

                        Areas of Specialization

                        479:

                        Selection Process for EDPMG 2026

                        480:

                        The candidates who satisfy the academic eligibility criteria (see below) can submit their applications online. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their academic eligibility, the Research Aptitude Test (RAT) and personal interview (PI). The RAT will test candidates on quantitative ability, verbal ability and research aptitude. RAT will be conducted on April 18, 2026. The shortlisted candidates from the RAT will be invited for PI, to be conducted in IIM Indore during April 19, 2026. The successful candidates will be made an offer to join the programme tentatively scheduled to start by mid-July 2026.

                        482:

                        Eligibility

                        483:

                        Candidates must have a Minimum of total  5 years of experience working as an Officer (Pay band level 11 and above as per the 7th CPC) in Indian Administrative Services and Indian Armed Forces as of the deadline of the application and also fulfil the requirement of the academic eligibility as mentioned below:

                        484:

                        Master’s degree in any discipline with at least 60 percent aggregate marks or equivalent grade point average.

                        486:

                        Postgraduate Diploma (2 years) with at least 60 percent aggregate marks or equivalent grade point average.

                        488:

                        Professional qualifications CA, ICWA, CS with at least 50 percent aggregate marks.

                        490:

                        A five year integrated Master’s degree program in any discipline, with at least 60 percent aggregate marks or equivalent grade point average.

                        492:

                        First Class/ equivalent Bachelor’s degree (4 year/8 semesters).

                        493:

                        In addition to the above academic eligibility, the candidate should have a minimum of 60 percent marks in Secondary (Class X) or Senior Secondary (Class XII) with second-class marks in other.

                        494:

                        Application Procedure

                        495:

                        For admissions 2026 EDPMG, IIM Indore is coordinating with Lal Bahadur Shastri National Academy of Administration (LBSNAA), Army War College (AWC)/Army Training Command (ARTRAC) in getting applications from the interested candidates for this programme. Service officers interested in this program, and meeting the eligibility criteria, are advised to write to DPM Office for the application form and submit the duly filled application form online to dpmoffice@iimidr.ac.in. Last date of submission of the application form is 14th March 2026.

                        496:

                        Candidates seeking admission to the Executive Doctoral Programme in Management and Governance (EDPMG) of IIM Indore should submit their application online latest by 14th March 2026, and pay the online non refundable/non-transferable application fee (including GST) of Rs. 3,540/- (Rupees Three Thousand Five Hundred and Forty only) (Application Fee – 3000/- + GST – 540/-). If applying for two areas pay an online non-refundable/non-transferable fee of Rs. 5310/- (Rupees Five Thousand Three Hundred Ten  only) + GST Extra (Application Fee – 4500/- + GST – 810/-).

                        527:

                        In the narration while transaction, you mention your name and programme applied.

                        530:

                        Programme Fee

                        531:

                        The total fee for the programme is Rs. 9,80,000/- (Rs. Nine Lakh Eighty Thousand only), as applicable at the time of admission payable in the following manner:

                        532:

                        Acceptance fee Rs.80,000/- (Rs. Eighty Thousand only) non-refundable payable before commencement of the programme in the academic year into which he/she is selected for admission.

                        540:

                        Each instalment has to be made between 03 weeks before the start of the course module of the programme.

                        541:

                        Programme Duration

                        542:

                        The programme duration is four years. Candidates should ensure that they complete the requirements of the programme within the stipulated time.  In case the candidate is not able to complete the programme in four years, they may be allowed to continue in the programme, subject to their progress, and with the payment of a continuation fee.

                        543:

                        Continuation Fee

                        544:

                        The students who go beyond the stipulated time may be allowed to continue in the programme subjected to their progress, and with the payment of continuation fee. However, the duration of the PhD must not exceed 06 years:

                        546:
                      • After completion of 04 years into the programme, the EDPMG participant may be allowed by EDPMG Executive Committee to continue in the programme after a review of their thesis progress report and recommendation of TAC on six monthly extension basis for a period of one year subject to payment of a continuation fee of Rs. 25,000/- every 06 months.
                        • 547:
                      • Further, after completion of 05 years into the programme, the EDPMG participant shall be required to make an appeal to the Director for further grant of extension by submitting their thesis progress report and plan of action, duly approved by TAC. In the event of grant of extension by the Director, such participants may be allowed to continue in the programme on a six monthly extension for a period of maximum of one year, subject to payment of a continuation fee of Rs. 50,000/- every 06 months.
                        • 548:
                      • Beyond 06 years there will be no consideration of any further extension and the participant shall be required to withdraw from the programme compulsorily.

                            DPM at IIMI

                            426:

                            The Doctoral Programme at IIMI is a unique doctoral programme in management. It is designed to provide both breadth and depth of knowledge to doctoral participants in management. The programme has two-fold objective of enabling the participants to master the relevant methodological tools of management research on one hand, and the advancement of the current body of management knowledge on the other. The DPM track offers prospects of a career within academia or in (research) positions outside the academia world. Programme’s rigorous curriculum provides ample training for an academic career and gives participants the opportunity to make an indelible mark on the research activity in their respective field. The programme offers specialization in various areas of management.

                            427:

                            With the rapid expansion of management education in India, it has become inevitable that top business schools cater to the need of the faculty by producing excellent researchers and academicians. The Doctoral programme in Management at IIMI is aimed to contribute to this societal need. All DPM students are fully funded during the course of their study upto four years.

                                426:

                                Executive Doctoral Programme in Management {formerly Fellow Programme in Management (Industry)} is a unique doctoral level programme in management for working professionals that culminates in a PhD in Management. The programme had a long legacy, started in the year 2011 it is amongst the first such programmes for working professionals offered by an IIM.  Till date 51 professionals have graduated from the programme and there are about 116 candidates across different batches currently enrolled in the programme.

                                427:

                                The Executive DPM Programme has evolved over the years and it currently offers a PhD degree. The programme offers a rigorous coursework and opportunity to pursue research in the guidance of some of the best researchers in the management domain.

                                435:

                                Doctoral Programmes at IIM Indore

                                436:

                                IIM Indore is a leading management institute in India and is well acclaimed internationally. It is ranked in among top 100 in FT list and is at number 8 in the NIRF list. IIM Indore is now the second IIM in the country to receive triple accreditations and the institute currently has all the three prominent accreditations — Association of MBAs (AMBA, UK); The Association to Advanced Collegiate Schools of Business (AACSB, USA); and EQUIS, European Union. This combination of accreditations is held by less than one percent of business schools in the world, granted by the largest and most influential business school accreditation agencies. 											 Academic Year 2026 – 27 
											 Introduction 
 The Executive Post Graduate Programme in Management (EPGP) is an intensive one-year full-time residential MBA program of IIM Indore. EPGP is specially designed for experienced professionals to enhance their knowledge, skills, and capabilities essential for managing and leading organizations. The programme combines skill building with the exploration of good management practices. This intensive one-year program helps participants gain the knowledge and skills required to excel in today’s fast-changing corporate environment. IIM Indore is again in the Top 100 Business Schools in the FT Rankings in the Global MBA Programmes 2026. IIM Indore has made a remarkable jump of 7 ranks, up from #69 in 2025 to #62 in 2026. Apart from the AMBA accreditation, EFMD Quality Improvement System (EQUIS), and US-based Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business (AACSB). This Triple Crown combination of accreditations is held by less than one percent of business schools in the world, granted by the largest and most influential business school accreditation agencies. In the EPGP programme, apart from the comprehensive functional core module, there are elective courses aligned with the industry concentration identified for the programme such as analytics, BFSI, e-Commerce, marketing, operations & strategy, etc.  The program carefully knits together all aspects of business and general management concepts, management philosophies, and varied academic theories. The curriculum of EPGP is a prudent mix of participant centric case-based learning, international immersion program, business analytics, industry consulting module, and guest lectures. 
 The inauguration for the 18th batch of IIM Indore EPGP for the academic year 2026-27 took place on April 3, 2026. The 2026-27 batch of EPGP comprises of 58 participants, including 11 women and 47 men, from a very diverse group of high calibre professionals from varied backgrounds, functional roles, and industries. The batch’s average experience is around seven years. 
 The EPGP is designed keeping in mind the following value propositions: 
 
 The courses should leverage the experience of the participants. 
 The courses should be aligned with the industry concentrations identified for EPGP. 
 The core courses should provide a general management perspective at an elevated pitch compared to the PGP program.

											 Programme Overview

 The IIM Indore two-year, alternate weekend Post Graduate  Programme in Management for Working Executives (PGPMX), offered in Mumbai, is uniquely designed for working executives and entrepreneurs, who would like to take the opportunity to become transformational leaders and innovative solution creators in their respective organizations, but find it difficult to pursue a full-time programme in management. PGPMX is designed to provide flexibility to working executives to be engaged in their respective professions and at the same time to upgrade their knowledge . Successful completion of the Programme would lead to the award of Master of Business Administration degree. 
 In 2025, IIM Indore's Weekend MBA - PGPMX programme also made a spectacular debut in the FT EMBA Rankings. IIM Indore has been ranked as the third-best Indian B-school in the world. Furthermore, the institute has been ranked 13th globally in the Career Progress category and ranked first in India. 
 The programme is also ranked among the Top 25 in Asia Pacific in the 2025 QS Executive MBA (EMBA). The institute is placed 3rd among the IIMs. On a global scale, the programme is placed in the 181+ bracket. 
 The PGPMX comprises of a rigorous curriculum, exposes participants to experiential learning, and provides avenues for creative collaborations with their peers, faculty, and their organizations. The PGPMX is similar in content and rigor to our regular Post-Graduate Programme in Management (PGP) and the classes are facilitated and taught by the same faculty. The objective of the programme is to provide participants with a platform to enhance their knowledge base, and hone their skills and competencies to grow higher in their career and to be a leader in their organizations. 
 The PGPMX innovative approach, need-based curriculum, powerful experiential learning, and experienced faculty deliver an integrated learning experience that is powerful enough to make a positive impact on the managerial career of the participants by maintaining high academic standards that is not just career-altering, but life-changing.

      Introduction

      416:

      Indian Institute of Management Indore (IIM Indore) has been practicing innovating teaching practices to attain its mission of being committed to excellence in management education, research and training, use of contemporary participant-centric pedagogies and teaching methods, and establishing a presence in emerging segments of management education. In this endeavor IIM Indore is committed to providing research and teaching skill enhancement programmes for fellow faculty of business schools in India. The Faculty Development Programmes (FDP) at IIM Indore are carefully designed to bridge the gap in quality research and teaching skills that are required in contemporary management education in India.

											 Executive Management Programme (EMP)– Batch 04 
											 Executive Management Programme (EMP) - Master of Management Studies (MMS) Batch 04 
 Associate for Technical and Student Support: 
 TimesPro, A Division of Bennett, Coleman & Co. Ltd. 
   
 Programme Overview 
 This programme is exclusively designed for working executives and entrepreneurs looking for major upskilling in management but finding it difficult to pursue a full-time programme. The classes will happen on the weekends (with a buffer provision of One session on Wednesdays), which will provide flexibility to the participants to be engaged in their respective professions and, at the same time, to upgrade their knowledge base. 
 The Programme contains courses from various management functions and covers contextual concepts highly relevant to the existing business environment. The courses will be taught by experts in the domain and delivered through cutting-edge technology to ensure the learning outcomes. 
 Programme USP 
 
 Contextually designed for working executives. 
 The programme faculty team includes the best of the domain experts. 
 Focus on case-study approach. 
 Democratize the higher education targeting professionals 
 
 
													 Apply Now 
												 
									 
								 
							 
								 
									 
											 
 Programme Contents 
 
 
 
 Term-I: Topic/Course Title* 
 
 
 ·       Communication in an Organisational Context 
 
 
 ·       Microeconomics for Managers 
 
 
 ·       Financial Accounting 
 
 
 ·       Statistics and Probability 
 
 
 ·       Marketing Management-I 
 
 
 ·       Operations Management 
 
 
 ·       Perspectives on Individual Dimensions 
 
 
 ·       Business Ethics and CSR 
 
 
 Term-II: Topic/Course Title* 
 
 
 ·       Macroeconomic Environment and Policy 
 
 
 ·       Financial System and Resources 
 
 
 ·       Marketing Management – II 
 
 
 ·       Operations Management- II 
 
 
 ·       WAC and Presentation Skills 

===== crawl_executive-programmes_degree-and-diploma-programmes_master-of-science-in-data-science-and-management_.html =====
										 
											 
												 
											 
										 
											
											 IIM Indore and IIT Indore Jointly Offer 
 a two-year  degree programme 
 Master of Science in Data Science and Management 
  (Blended Learning Mode) 
    Enquiry Form     |      For detailed information    |     DMAT Sample Question Paper 
 
									 
								 
							 
								 
									 
											 
 About Programme 
 
 Business problems need to be jointly addressed by managers and data analysts. Decisions based on analytics need to be made by managers, which they can do only if they understand the data science tools and techniques. Generally, the programmes offered in this domain have focused more on some specific tools and techniques while the business context in which these tools have been applied have received less attention. Hence, a comprehensive programme that focuses both on business knowledge and technical expertise is needed. The IIT and IIMs ‘Master’s in Data Science and Management’ programme will provide better education to future data scientists. The programme will cover general concepts on algorithms, data structures, big data infrastructure, big data analytics life cycle, data security and management, contemporary management thoughts including behavior elements. 
 Programme Objectives 
 In today’s environment to remain relevant managers and entrepreneurs need to develop data-driven paradigm to solve new classes of problems which we were not able to solve in the past. Data sciences field is having amazing impact on every aspect of our lives and society. 
Education in data science is the key to success and IIT and IIM’s Mater of Science in Data Science and Management programme will provide better education to future data scientists. The programme will cover general concepts on algorithms, data structures, big data infrastructure, big data analytics life cycle, data security and management, contemporary management thoughts including behavior elements. There are four pillars to this programme, i.e., Data, Technology, People, Enterprise Strategy. These pillars are constructed to cultivate the much-required skills for data scientists, i.e., leadership skills, communication skills, eye for business and value, project management, big data analytics life cycle, big data technologies and solutions, data management skills, systems thinking. 
 
 
 Course Content: 
 The programme structure is divided into six trimesters from basic to advanced courses.The trimester I to trimester IV of the programme will cover the following broad topics: 
 
 Advanced Machine Learning 
 Algorithms 
 Business Analytics 
 Business Research 
 Data Structures 
 Data Visualization 
 Database Management System 
 Design Thinking 
 Ethics 
 Financial Management 
 Generating Business Value with Story Telling and Insights 
 Human Resource Management 
 Information Systems for Managers 
 Introduction to AI 
 Legal Aspects of Business 
 Linear Optimization 
 Machine Learning Foundations 
 Managerial Communication 
 Managerial Economics 
 Marketing Management 
 Mathematical and Statistical Methods for Data Science – 1 
 Mathematical and Statistical Methods for Data Science – 2 
 Operations Management 
 Organizational Behaviour 
 Probability and Statistics 
 Programming Fundamentals for Data Science 
 Research Methodology 
 Spreadsheet Modeling 
 Strategic Management 
 Supply Chain Management 
 Understanding Financial Statements and Functions of Finance 
 
 In the fifth trimester, participants will be offered a pool of electives to choose from the advanced courses offered by the two Institutes. 
 In the sixth trimester, participants will also be a part of the project work and will be working under the direction of expert faculty from both the Institutes. 
 

										 
									 
								 
							 
								 
										 
 Eligibility 
 A first class degree in B.Tech./B.E./B.S./B.Pharm./B.Arch./B.Des./B.FTech./Four-year B.Sc./M.Sc./MCA/MBA, 
 OR 
 An equivalent qualification with at least two courses in Mathematics and one course in Computer Programming at the qualifying degree level. 
 Qualifying Examination

													 Executive Post Graduate Diploma Programme in Management & Artificial Intelligence (EPGDPM&AI) (Batch 05) Master of Science in Data Science and Management Executive Management Programme – Government, Public Administration and Defence [EMP – (G&D)] Executive Management Programme (EMP)– Batch 04 
												 
											 
										 
									 
								 
								 
									 
										 
											 
												 
											 
										 
											 Executive Management Programme – Government, Public Administration and Defence `{`EMP (G&D)`}` 
											 Application Form     |      Brochure    
 
 The Application Deadline has been Extended to 31st August 2024 
 
 Programme Overview 
 The EMP (G&D) is a 2-year blended mode executive education programme leading to a Master of Management Studies (MMS) degree. The programme is designed uniquely to provide a comprehensive understanding of management, public policy, governance, and national security related aspects to serving officers in the defence forces and civil servants. The EPM (G&D) programme as a rigorous programme with focus on core domains in management alongside relevant subjects in public policy, governance, sustainability, and national security. 
 Programme USP 
 
 Contextually designed for serving officers in the Defence forces and Civil Servants. 
 The programme faculty team includes the best of the domain experts. 
 Focus on case-study approach. 
 
 
 
									 
								 
							 
								 
									 
											 
 Programme Contents 
 
 Communications 
 Microeconomics for Policy Decisions 
 Introduction to Policy Analysis 
 Statistics and Probability 
 Operations Management 
 Governance: Theoretical Perspectives 
 Macroeconomic Environment and Policy 
 Financial Management 
 Econometrics for Policy Analysis 
 Information Systems and Governance 
 Strategic Management and Public Policy 
 Marketing Management 
 National Security and Foreign Policies 
 Principles of Leadership 
 Culture and Society 
 Introduction to Research Method 
 Public Administration / Digital Governance 
 Perspectives on Individual and Group Dimensions 
 Policy and Programme Evaluation 
 Law, Institutions and Public Policy 
 Sustainability 
 
 In term 4, 5 and 6 we would offer specialised elective courses and in term 5 and 6 participants will also be a part of the project/ simulation and policy paper. 
 *The course contents/timelines above are tentative and may be changed if required. 
 Note: Medium of instruction: English,   Modules/ topics are indicative only, and the suggested time and sequence may be dropped/ modified/adapted to fit the participant profile & programme hours. 
 
 
 Admission Criteria 
 The selection will be based on candidate’s profile evaluation, subject to meeting eligibility criteria, aptitude test and a personal interview with the faculty from IIM Indore. Final decision on candidate admission will be made by IIM Indore. 
 Eligibility Criteria 
 
 Serving ‘Group A’ officer with a minimum 10 Years of full time service   
 
 OR 
 
 Serving Commissioned Officer (Group A) in Indian Army, Indian Navy, or Indian Airforce with minimum 10 Years of full time service . 
 
 AND

											 Executive Post Graduate Diploma Programme in Management & Artificial Intelligence (EPGDPM&AI) (Batch 05) 
											 Associate for Technical and Student Support:   
 TimesPro, A Division of Bennett, Coleman & Co. Ltd. 
 Apply Online 
 The 15-month Executive Post Graduate Diploma Programme in Management & Artificial Intelligence aims to aid participants in elevating their respective careers & leading the AI-driven digital revolution by upskilling themselves in state-of-the-art concepts and applications by offering a powerful mix of Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning & Management skills. With its robust curriculum, designed and delivered by seasoned industry experts and award-winning faculties from IIM Indore and TimesPro, this online instructor-led programme covers Business Management, Building AI Teams, Managerial Economics, Strategic Management concepts, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Machine Vision, Conversational AI, Data Science, Big Data, and a lot more. The Executive Alumni Status further offers a unique opportunity to become a part of IIM Indore’s vast Alumni network & leverage several benefits as an IIM alumnus once they make a one-time nominal fee payment. 
 
									 
								 
							 
							 
						 			 
						 	 
							 	 Programme USP 
							 	
							 
							 
							 
						 	 
						 
						 Equal emphasis on theories and projects to encourage a 'Learning-By-Doing’ concept 

						 
							 
						 	 
						 
						 Participants will be able to appreciate AI’s role in the Digital Economy and to recognize the potential and impact of AI and ML in their business 

						 
							 
						 	 
						 
						 They will be able to advocate ROI and benefits of AI adoption 

						 
							 
						 They will be able to understand that AI and ML has broader application in business processes (e.g., in terms of automation)

 Eligibility Criteria 
 
 50% marks (or equivalent GPA) in bachelor’s degree 
 Work Experience - Minimum 3 Years full time paid work experience after graduation (Entrepreneurial experience included).

            436:

            The last date for submission of online applications for EDPM 2026 is Saturday, 14th March 2026.

            439:

            For its Executive Doctoral Programme in Management (EDPM), IIM Indore seeks high-quality candidates with strong academic background, preferably with professional experience, and intellectual curiosity needed for scholarship in management. The last date for submission of online application is 14 March 2026.

            443:
          • Communication
            • 453:

            Out of the aforementioned areas, an applicant can choose any two areas of specialization only and submit his/her application along with all attachments as required and mentioned in the online Application Form. Candidates are encouraged to check the individual faculty research profiles in their areas of specialization to understand the research interests of the faculty.

            454:

            Eligibility (Work Experience and Academic)

            455:

            Candidates must have a Minimum 5 years of managerial/ entrepreneurial/ professional experience after graduation/master’s as on the application deadline date (refer to Admission Brochure) and also fulfil the requirement of the academic eligibility as mentioned below:

            456:

            Master’s degree in any discipline with at least 60 percent aggregate marks or equivalent grade point average.

            458:

            Postgraduate Diploma (2 years) with at least 60 percent aggregate marks or equivalent grade point average.

            460:

            Professional qualifications CA, ICWA, CS with at least 50 percent aggregate marks.

            462:

            A five-year integrated Master’s degree program in any discipline, with at least 60 percent aggregate marks or equivalent grade point average.

            464:

            First Class/ equivalent Bachelor’s degree (4 year/8 semesters).

            466:

            In addition to the above academic eligibility criteria, the candidate should have a minimum of 60 percent marks either in Secondary (Class X) or Senior Secondary (Class XII) with second class marks in other.

            467:

            The candidate must hold a bachelor’s degree, awarded by any of the universities incorporated by an act of the central or the state legislature in India or other educational institutions established by an act of Parliament or declared to be deemed as a University under section 3 of UGC Act, 1956, or possess an equivalent qualification recognized by the Ministry of HRD, Government of India.

            468:

            The equivalence of the foreign degree needs to be certified by the Association of Indian Universities. The bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification obtained by the candidate must entail a minimum of three years of education after completing higher secondary schooling (10+2) or equivalent.

            469:

            The percentage of marks obtained by the candidate in the bachelor’s degree would be based on the practice followed by the institution/university from where the candidate has obtained the degree. In case of the candidates being awarded grades/CGPA instead of marks, the equivalence would be based on the equivalence certified by the institution/university from where they have obtained a bachelor’s degree.

            471:

            The percentage of marks obtained in Class X and Class XII would be the aggregate marks of all subjects that appear in the mark sheet of grade sheet, irrespective of whether the Board considers them for calculation of percentage.

            481:Communication 482:CAT/GRE/GMAT/JRF / RAT* 486:CAT/ GRE/GMAT/JRF in Economics/ RAT* 490:CAT/ GMAT/GRE/JRF/ RAT* 494:CAT/ GMAT/ GATE/ GRE/ JRF/ RAT* 498:CAT/ GMAT / GATE / GRE/ RAT* 502:CAT/GATE/GRE/GMAT/ RAT* 506:CAT/ GMAT / GATE / GRE / JRF/ RAT* 510:CAT/GATE in Psychology or Sociology/ GMAT/GRE/ JRF/ RAT* 514:CAT/ GRE/GMAT/ JRF/ RAT* 518:

            The validity of the CAT and the other standard test scores are given in the following table. Note that the scores should be valid on the deadline for submission of the application form.

            519:

            CAT – 3 years
            520:GRE – 3 years
            521:GMAT – 3 years
            522:GATE – 3 years
            523:JRF – 3 years

            527:

            Application Procedure

            528:

            Candidates seeking admission to the Executive Doctoral Programme in Management (EDPM) of IIM Indore should submit their application online between December 25, 2025 to March 14, 2026, and pay the online non refundable/non-transferable application fee of Rs. 3000/- (Rupees Three thousand only) + GST extra. If applying for two areas pay online non-refundable/non-transferable fee of Rs. 4500/- (Rupees Four Thousand Five Hundred only) + GST Extra.

            530:

            The candidates will be shortlisted (on the recommendation of the respective areas) on the based information provided in the application form. The selection process is as follows:

            531:

            Stage 1: The candidates satisfying the academic eligibility criteria as mentioned above should submit their application online.

            532:

            Stage 2: Based on the applications received, candidates satisfying Academic eligibility criteria and acceptable standard test the shortlisting will be done by the respective Areas and candidates will be called for Personal Interview (PI), to be conducted at IIM Indore during April.

            539:

            A candidate can submit the Online application with all the attachments by the application deadline date.

            542:

            While filling the online application form, a scanned copy of the documents must be uploaded wherever it has been asked for.

            545:

            Please note that mere fulfilling of the minimum qualifications will not make a candidate eligible for admissions into EDPM

            546:

            Your complete application should include

            549:
          • Educational qualification
            • 554:
          • Payment of application fee (as applicable)
            • 577:

            Programme Duration

            578:

            The programme duration is four years. Candidates should ensure that they complete the requirements of the programme within this stipulated time. In case a candidate is not able to complete the programme in four years, they may be allowed to continue in the programme depending upon their progress and with payment of continuation fee but not beyond 06 years.

            582:

            The students who go beyond the above stipulated time may be allowed to continue in the programme depending upon their progress and with payment of continuation fee but not beyond 06 years as under:

            583:

            After completion of 04 years into the programme, the EDPM participant may be allowed by EDPM Executive Committee to continue in the programme after reviewing his/her thesis progress report and recommendation of TAC on six monthly extension basis for a period of one year subject to payment of a continuation fee of Rs. 25,000/- every 06 months.

            584:

            After completion of 05 years into the programme, the EDPM participant shall be required to make an appeal to Director for further grant of extension by submitting his/her thesis progress report and plan of action duly approved by TAC.               441:

              443:

              445:

              447:

              449:

              452:

              • 455:

              Candidates who are in the final year of their qualifying programmes that would make them eligible can also apply. Such candidates, if selected, will be allowed to join the programme provisionally only if they submit a certificate latest by June, issued by the Principal/ Head of the Department / Registrar or Director of the University / Institute stating that they have appeared for the examinations (including practical examinations) in all the subjects required for obtaining the Master’s / Bachelor’s degree / equivalent qualification. Their admission will be confirmed only when they submit the marks sheet and the certificate of having passed the Master’s / Bachelor’s degree/equivalent qualification referred to in the certificate issued by Principal / Registrar of their college / Institute. The deadline for submission of marks sheet and the Certificate is December. The candidates who have applied on the basis of their bachelor’s or master’s degree will have to meet the eligibility criteria as specified earlier. Non-fulfilment of these conditions will automatically result in the cancellation of the provisional admission.

              456:

              The candidate must hold a bachelor’s degree, awarded by any of the universities incorporated by an act of the central or the state legislature in India or other educational institutions established by an act of Parliament or declared to be deemed as a University under section 3 of UGC Act, 1956, or possess an equivalent qualification recognized by the Ministry of HRD, Government of India.

              457:

              The equivalence of the foreign degree needs to be certified by the Association of Indian Universities. The bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification obtained by the candidate must entail a minimum of three years of education after completing higher secondary schooling (10+2) or equivalent.

              458:

In case of the candidates being awarded grades/CGPA instead of marks, the equivalence would be based on the equivalence certified by the institution/university from where they have obtained a bachelor’s degree.

              460:

              531:

              Application Procedure

              532:

              Candidates seeking admissions to the Doctoral Programme in Management (DPM) of IIM Indore should submit their application online between December 16, 2025, to February 28, 2026,  and pay the online nonrefundable/non-transferable application fee of Rs. 1000/- (Rupees one thousand only) + GST extra for General, NC-OBC and EWS category and Rs. 500/-(Rupees five hundred only) + GST extra for SC, ST, and PWD categories.

              533:

              Candidates belonging to NC-OBC, SC, ST, EWS and PWD categories need to produce a valid certificate(s) in support of their reservation category. No change in the category will be entertained after submitting the application.

              535:

              The candidates will be shortlisted (on the recommendation of the respective areas) on the based information provided in the application form. The selection process is as follows:

              536:

              Stage 1: The candidates satisfying the academic eligibility criteria as mentioned above should submit their application online.

              537:

              540:

              Only the candidates satisfying the requirements mentioned in earlier stages will be considered for the final selection. Category-wise and Academic Area-wise merit list will be generated based on the performance in the Personal Interviews and the provisional admission offers will be made.

              543:
